Honoring Our Pact to Veterans | Representative Frank Mrvan Skip to main content Honoring Our Pact to Veterans Throughout his career as an elected official, Rep. Mrvan has worked to support the health and livelihoods of veterans.  Rep. Mrvan previously had the honor to serve on the House Veterans’ Affairs Committee.  In the 118th Congress, Rep. Mrvan served as the Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Oversight and Investigations, which has oversight and investigative jurisdiction over programs and operations of the Department of Veterans Affairs, as well as those of other federal agencies that pertain to veterans.  The Subcommittee also oversees the implementation of VA programs including the Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) program and implementation of the Honoring our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics (PACT) Act law, which treats toxic exposure as a cost of war by addressing the full range of issues impacting toxic-exposed veterans and is the most significant expansion to VA health care in 30 years.  Rep. Mrvan will continue to build upon his legislative accomplishments on behalf of veterans in the 118th Congress, including the Veterans Health Administration Leadership Transformation Act to improve leadership stability within the Veterans Health Administration (VHA), which was included in the Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare and Benefits Improvements Act and passed the House.  Rep. Mrvan also introduced the Veterans’ Security and Pay Transparency Act to improve recruitment and retention of U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Police Officers and the VA Acquisition Review Board Act to create a formal structure for the review and approval of major acquisition programs at VA.  Additionally, Rep. Mrvan introduced and the Gold Star Family Education Parity Act to make veterans' dependents and survivors eligible for superior education benefits. In the 117th Congress, Rep. Mrvan served as Chairman of the House Veterans' Affairs Subcommittee on Technology Modernization and introduced four pieces of legislation that were signed into law, including the  Department of Veteran Affairs

Supporting Organized Labor | Representative Frank Mrvan Skip to main content Supporting Organized Labor Congressman Mrvan knows that organized labor is the foundation of the strength of the Northwest Indiana economy.  During the 119th Congress, he proudly serves as the Vice Chairman of the Congressional Steel Caucus and as a member of the Congressional Labor Caucus.  Additionally, Rep. Mrvan serves as the Chair of the New Democrat Coalition's Workforce & Education Working Group. During his first two terms in office, Rep. Mrvan served on the House Committee on Education and Labor, where he advocated for all workers and labor organizations who are on the front lines of supporting our national economy and our national security.  Through his work on the House Appropriations Committee, Rep. Mrvan continues to support initiatives aimed at strengthening job training and workforce development initiatives, workplace safety, health benefits, and retirement security for workers.  Additionally, Rep. Mrvan has been an outspoken supporter for the reauthorization of the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WOIA), to help workers acquire skills to enter the workforce without a college degree.  He also supports the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, because he understands that the ability to form unions is essential to continuing to create more good-paying job opportunities and an economy that works for everyone.   Rep. Mrvan will continue to work to support all workers and members of organized labor, and will continue to look for opportunities to advocate for apprenticeship programs, Davis-Bacon wage protection requirements, and the use of project labor agreements.  More on Supporting Organized Labor Mrvan Introduces the PRO-WORK Act to Prevent Companies that Lock Out Workers from Receiving Federal Funds August 31, 2026 Press Release Washington, DC – Today, Rep. Frank J. Mrvan introduced the PRO-WORK (Preventing Revenue Opportunities for Workplace Lockouts and Retaliation) Act, which would prohibit corporations that lock out their workers from doing business with the federal government. Appropriations & Federal Funding | Representative Frank Mrvan Skip to main content Appropriations & Federal Funding In the 119th Congress, Rep. Mrvan is proud to serve on the House Appropriations Committee.  As a public servant, Rep. Mrvan knows that the House Appropriations Committee is the heart of improving government services and making a positive difference in the lives of individuals and families in communities in Northwest Indiana and across our nation and the world.  The House Appropriations Committee is responsible for funding the federal government's vital activities to keep the United States safe, strong, and moving forward.  Rep. Mrvan looks forward to advancing policies that clearly define our nation’s values and priorities through the federal funding process. Congressman Mrvan serves on the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Commerce, Justice, and Science.  Through this Subcommittee, he will focus on providing adequate and appropriate funds, oversight, and direction for the International Trade Commission, which is responsible for defending our domestic manufacturing workforce from unfair trade practices, the Department of Commerce, which promotes economic development and job creation programs, and the Department of Justice, which invests in local first responder and law enforcement agencies. Congressman Mrvan also serves on the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Energy and Water Development.  Through this Subcommittee, Congressman Mrvan will focus on supporting the work of the Department of Energy and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, which includes resources and funds for sewer, water infrastructure, and economic development projects in Northwest Indiana.   Throughout his career, Congressman Mrvan has worked to identify federal, state, local, private and nonprofit resources that allow Northwest Indiana residents to get a good-paying job, take care of their family, and succeed in a career that allows them to have a good quality of life.  In the 119th Congress, Rep. Building an Economy that Works for Everyone | Representative Frank Mrvan Skip to main content Building an Economy that Works for Everyone Rep. Mrvan believes that more work must be done to build an economy that works for everyone and that provides education and economic opportunities for all. Throughout his career, Congressman Mrvan has worked to identify federal, state, local, private and nonprofit resources that allow Northwest Indiana residents to get a good-paying job, take care of their family, and succeed in a career that allows them to have a good quality of life. In the 119th Congress, he will continue to use his years of experience to work with all stakeholders to create more economic opportunities for everyone and help retain and attract investments to Indiana’s First Congressional District. Rep. Mrvan supported the American Rescue Plan in order to get past the pandemic and build momentum to grow our economy.  This legislation resulted in the quickest economic recovery in our nation’s history and record-low unemployment rates.  Rep. Mrvan also supported the Bipartisan Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, the largest investment in our nation’s infrastructure since the creation of the National Highway System in the 1950’s.  This legislation provides Indiana with approximately $6.9 billion over five years in federal funding to repair highways, roads, bridges, ports, airports, and waterways throughout our state.  Additionally, Rep. Mrvan fought to include the strongest Buy America requirements in our nation's history in this legislation to ensure American-made products are utilized in these infrastructure projects.  Moving forward, the Congressman will continue working to implement legislation with the goal of creating work and wealth for communities across Northwest Indiana.  He will also continue to focus on assisting Northwest Indiana through the extension and expansion of the South Shore Rail Line, enhancing the Gary/Chicago International Airport, and increasing visitors to the Indiana Dunes National Park. Vice Chairman of Congressional Steel Caucus | Representative Frank Mrvan Skip to main content Vice Chairman of Congressional Steel Caucus In the 119th Congress, Rep. Mrvan is honored to serve as Vice Chairman of the Congressional Steel Caucus. The Congressional Steel Caucus is a bipartisan group of over 100 Members of Congress who represent regions with steel manufacturers or care about the health of the American steel industry.  In addition to introducing legislation supporting the domestic steel community. Caucus members routinely meet with Administration officials and international organization representatives to communicate the interests of the American industry and its steelworkers.  The steel industry has been central to Northwest Indiana's way of life since the first mills arrived on the Lake Michigan shoreline over 100 years ago. Today, the American manufacturing industry faces threats on several fronts. At home, loopholes in Buy America protections have prevented the use of American steel on infrastructure projects.  Abroad, illegally-subsidized imports from foreign nations continue to flood the market.  During these difficult times, Rep. Mrvan believes that we must fight for every single American manufacturing and steel job.  That is why Rep. Mrvan has testified on multiple occasions before the International Trade Commission and will continue to fight to ensure that all American trade laws are fully enforced, that Section 232 steel tariffs are continued, and that strong and expanded Buy America requirements are applied to appropriations and infrastructure legislation.  More on Vice Chairman of Congressional Steel Caucus Mrvan Introduces the PRO-WORK Act to Prevent Companies that Lock Out Workers from Receiving Federal Funds August 31, 2026 Press Release Washington, DC – Today, Rep.
